objective: Diagnose and harden the Crossref live qualification probe after the corrected versioned endpoint still returned HTTP 404.

rulesConsidered: IMPLEMENTED and QUALIFIED remain separate lifecycle states.
The qualification harness may only record QUALIFIED from real provider evidence.
The Crossref probe remains advisory/control-plane only and does not gain authority over F00, Treasury, ComputeRouter, F06, CAS, F07, or Overseer.

notes: Crossref request evidence uses the existing secret-bearing URL redaction helper.
Only a bounded provider response-body preview is retained for Crossref diagnostics.
The User-Agent is descriptive and may include CROSSREF_MAILTO only when explicitly configured.

changes: Moved the Crossref current base to the explicitly versioned https://api.crossref.org/v1 route and kept /works as the resource path.
Simplified the representative capability probe to rows=1 with select=DOI,title and removed query.bibliographic from the live proof path.
Added a descriptive User-Agent and optional CROSSREF_MAILTO for the polite pool.
Preserved the redacted request URL, final URL, response shape, and bounded provider response-body preview when Crossref returns non-2xx.
Added deterministic regression coverage for the request contract and non-2xx diagnostics.

externalVerification.rationale: Crossref documents the versioned /v1/works route and recommends identifying clients with a descriptive User-Agent and optional mailto.

verificationPlan: Pass Team Change Gate, OKF Governance, API Provider Fabric Verification, and repository CI.
Merge PR #208 to main only after required validation succeeds.
Run Crossref live qualification from main and inspect the captured request URL and provider response body.
Mark Crossref QUALIFIED only if a real live response returns a representative message.items array and the evidence sufficiency gate passes.
notes: This PR does not change the Crossref provider disposition in #184.
A live 404 remains an observed provider/runtime failure until the new diagnostic run identifies the cause or proves the endpoint healthy.
